rdfs:label: LinguisticSystem
rdfs:comment: A system of communication including written, spoken, signed, or symbolic languages.
notes: Use as @type for resources representing languages — typically referenced from `urn:solid:language` when you need a structured Language resource rather than a bare BCP 47 tag. Common IRI sources: id.loc.gov ISO 639-1/639-2 (http://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/iso639-2/eng), Lexvo, or the EU language authority table; for a bare BCP 47 tag use a literal on `urn:solid:language`.

history.note: Corrected IRI-source guidance (IANA subtag registry has no per-language URIs); removed unrelated vCard hasLanguage from seeAlso.
